description: Starts from high Inside Lion (have hip above bar).  Hand matching knee hook leg to top of bar with palms away grip (close to tab). Rotate belly to floor.  Exit back to Inside Lion by dropping booty and reblocking shoulder.

name: Half Beauty Roll
description:
Inside Lion
Arm of free leg reaches up and through hoop for Flamenco Grip (hand between top of hoop and tab so there is room for head to pass through)
Head slides out between arm and hoop
Lean back so free arm can pass through body and side of hoop
As arm passes through, turn shoulders to face it, straighten arm and use the back of that arm to push hoop away
Pull up with top arm, straightening legs (to avoid crotch), and pass body through space by following the arm
Inside Lion on opposite side
From Inside Lion, hand that matches knee hook grabs top of bar with palm towards you. Head and shoulders out the back. Cross grip on side of the bar and legs to RM or Candlestick.

From Inside Lion, knee hook leg hand is top of hoop with palm toward you with free leg hand reaching for bar under knee hook leg. Top arm then moves to side of bar, so it’s under that armpit.  Knee hook leg traces hoop into Wine Glass.  Tip:  farther you lean back the easier the transition.
Hand that matches knee hook goes above tab palm toward you. Other arm will be posting arm. Pull with top hand and push with bottom hand. Engage core and bring feet up to hoop.
progressions: Regression would be to bring one foot up first.
